answer_1.quote: Our method generates a story given a short paragraph. ... This is more challenging than generating the drama script given a complete story.
datasets: Seven People In the Station script (high‑quality manual script)
answer_1.outputs: dramatic story (~500 words) and interactive dialogue scripts for LLM agents

answer_3.quote: Then, we vote for the best story by querying three additional independent LLMs (line 8). ... we introduce a critic LLM B to evaluate the output by A.

answer_4.quote: We employ six annotators. All of them are native speakers with a background in humanities ... We ask the annotators to rate each dimension using an integer score from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate multiple dimensions such as Character Consistency, Character Attractiveness, Immersion, Agency, Narrative Completeness, Narrative Progression, Player Influence, Intention Following.
